answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in onyx and opal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1735 impostors cost 1554 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
